final: WITH driver_totals AS (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) as driver_total FROM results WHERE points > 0 GROUP BY driverId), overall_total_cte AS (SELECT SUM(driver_total) as overall_total FROM driver_totals), avg_driver_total_cte AS (SELECT AVG(driver_total) as avg_driver_total FROM driver_totals), kept_drivers AS (SELECT dt.driver_total, ot.overall_total, adt.avg_driver_total, dt.driver_total / ot.overall_total as ratio, dt.driver_total - adt.avg_driver_total as difference FROM driver_totals dt CROSS JOIN overall_total_cte ot CROSS JOIN avg_driver_total_cte adt WHERE dt.driver_total > adt.avg_driver_total) SELECT AVG(driver_total) as avg_kept_driver_total, AVG(ratio) as avg_kept_ratio, AVG(difference) as avg_difference FROM kept_drivers
